shots.image: Night, the burglar (black balaclava, black-and-white striped sweater, black gloves) sits in a dark parked car, his face lit blue by his smartphone, zooming into a photo with two fingers, eyes wide, huge mischievous grin. Close-up.
shots.animate: He zooms into the photo with two fingers, his grin slowly widens, the phone light flickers on his face. Static camera.

shots.image: Cosy guard room at night, Gérard the chubby mustached security guard with glasses and yellow hi-vis vest proudly holds up his smartphone at arm's length for a selfie, a small cake with one candle and his thermos on the desk, big proud smile.
shots.animate: Gérard raises the phone, poses with a proud smile and a thumbs up, the candle flame flickers. Static camera.

shots.image: Medium close-up of Gérard happily posting on his smartphone, his security badge clipped very visibly on the chest of his yellow vest, thumb on the screen.
shots.animate: He taps the screen to post, nods proudly, the badge swings slightly on his vest. Static camera.

shots.image: Gérard grinning in the foreground taking a selfie; behind him on the wall, clearly visible: a big planning board with colored blocks, a door keypad and an open key cabinet full of keys.
shots.animate: Slow push-in past Gérard toward the planning board, keypad and key cabinet behind him while he keeps smiling. Smooth camera move.

shots.image: The burglar in his dark hideout, phone screen glow on his face, his eyes huge and sparkling with delight, rubbing his gloved hands together, comically evil.
shots.animate: He zooms on the phone, his eyes widen, then he rubs his gloved hands together with an evil grin. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, the burglar holds a badge against the reader of a warehouse service door, the reader light glows green and the door is opening; Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat watches from a trash bin, unimpressed.
shots.animate: He swipes the badge, the light turns green, the door swings open and he slips inside; the cat follows him with its eyes. Static camera.

shots.image: Daytime guard room, Inès the security technician with a black ponytail and grey jacket with reflective stripes holds up a smartphone toward Gérard and points at the screen sternly; Gérard looks guilty and small.
shots.animate: Inès shakes the phone toward Gérard and taps the screen, Gérard shrinks and scratches his neck in embarrassment. Static camera.

shots.image: Gérard taking a selfie cheek to cheek with Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat who looks deeply annoyed, plain brick wall behind them and nothing else.
shots.animate: Gérard grins and snaps the selfie, the cat rolls its eyes and flicks its tail. Static camera.
